title: USB Phone Display
activeTooltip: Phone display active · Left: stop · Right: settings
readyTooltip: Phone ready · Left: start · Right: settings
disconnected: Connect one USB phone and authorize USB debugging.
settingsHint: Stop the display to change settings. USB speed and phone decoding determine actual frame rate.
saveFailed: Could not save preferences in Omarchy shell.json.
setupPackagesBody: Run this command in an Omarchy terminal. You can select and copy it below.
setupAvnc: 2. Install AVNC on your Android phone
setupAvncBody: Install AVNC (package com.gaurav.avnc) from F-Droid or its official releases, then open it once. This plugin cannot stream without AVNC.
avncUnknown: Connect and authorize the phone so we can check for AVNC.
avncReady: AVNC is installed on the connected phone.
avncMissing: AVNC is not installed on the connected phone. Install it, then press Recheck.
setupUsbBody: On Android: Settings → About phone → tap Build number seven times. Open Developer options and enable USB debugging. Connect a data-capable cable, unlock the phone, and accept the RSA authorization prompt. Connect one phone at a time.
setupProfileBody: Save a server named exactly vnc://127.0.0.1 with address 127.0.0.1 and port 5900. Use direct TCP, Raw off, image quality 5, and Touchscreen gestures. Disable Resize remote desktop. Use fullscreen and Fit to screen if you previously changed zoom.
setupRotateBody: Turn on Android Auto-rotate. In AVNC, set the viewer and saved server orientation to Automatic. Choose Follow phone in Display. The desktop changes shape after Android rotates its screen; manual Portrait and Landscape are also available.
setupStartBody: Open Display, use Phone native resolution, and drag the phone beside a monitor. Then press Start or left-click the bar icon. Dragging a running display applies its new position immediately.
rotationLocked: Android rotation lock is on. Enable Auto-rotate to follow physical phone rotation.
keepAwakeHint: Uses adb shell svc power stayon true. This changes an Android preference that persists after stopping the display. Uncheck to explicitly turn it off; the phone can still be locked manually.
phoneDrag: Drag phone display; arrow keys place it beside the first monitor
dragHint: Drag the phone above, below, left or right of a monitor. Edges snap together. Existing desktop monitors stay fixed. Arrow keys also move the focused phone.
rotationHint: Follow phone needs Android Auto-rotate and AVNC Automatic orientation. Native resolution avoids black borders. Stop before changing resolution, scale, or refresh rate.
chargingShortHint: Uses ADB to keep Android awake on power. This setting stays on after stopping; switch it off here to disable it.
setupSubtitle: Ready checks first. Expand any row for instructions.
